name: Scholarship to Disabled Students
benefit:
**Scholarship Assistance:**

- ₹1,500/- per year for students with disabilities studying in Class 1st to 8th.
- ₹2,000/- to ₹4,500 per year for students studying in Class 9th and above.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a student. - The applicant must have at least 40% of any of the 21 benchmark disabilities listed under the [Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/15939/1/the_rights_of_persons_with_disabilities_act%2C_2016.pdf). - The applicant should have passed the last annual examination with a minimum of 40% marks. - The applicant should possess a valid PH (Person with Disability) Identity Card. - The applicant should be currently studying in a recognized educational institution.
